column1: # Routing eval prompts for the alis-build:discover skill.
# Columns (tab-separated): prompt <TAB> expect_fire (yes|no) <TAB> category
# Categories:
#   platform  - platform-shaped user language; discovery should fire (yes)
#   generic   - generic coding with no platform surface; must NOT fire (no)
#   wake-word - explicitly addresses alis; must fire (yes)
#   ambiguous - judgement calls; the expectation column records the outcome we
#               deem reasonable given the discover skill's contract:
#               * "build it" / "deploy this to production" are direct DBD
#                 commands on an already-known target -> CLI directly, no
#                 discovery (no);
#               * "add caching to the search endpoint" is build work inside an
#                 alis.build workspace with no skill loaded -> discovery (yes);
#               * "why is terraform complaining..." names Terraform, a listed
#                 platform trigger -> discovery (yes);
#               * "set up authentication for my app" names no platform noun and
#                 is plausibly generic -> no fire (no).
